description: Vanilla-facing source sets of port/mc/shared. A profile compiles the shared roots (port/src/main/java, port/overrides/client/src/main/java), then every set whose selects match its port/versions/*.json fields, in this order, then the target roots. port/tools/sourcesets/sourcesets.mjs resolves and stages them; see README.md.

sets.name: canonical
sets.description: Written against the canonical render seam generation (the oldest non-LTS generation of the support window); profile fields are bound for every profile and types are relocated for newer generations.

sets.name: renderpearl-1
sets.description: The renderpearl-1 generation: semantic adapters, remaining generation-specific sources, excludes, and type relocations.

sets.name: legacy-12111
sets.description: The compat set of the LTS profile: retained ABI-specific files and excludes, with individually reviewed similarity exceptions.
